title: Closing a Northgate+ Business Membership: Business Refund Schedule and Administrator Confirmation
content:
**Scope.** For the immediate cancellation of a Northgate+ Business membership of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships whose most recent settled annual fee was charged to an external card, and only for such a cancellation, the refund is worked out under this Business closure schedule.

**The business's decision.** The closure is the business's own decision; its administrator confirms it, the membership closes on the cancellation date, and the Business refund is credited to the external card the fee was charged to. A line's net amount is the amount charged for the line after item promotions and the Northgate Card discount.

**When the Business refund is worked out.** The tier's annual Northgate Cash limit is its annual earn cap.

The Business refund is worked out only after the line recorded first on the member's Northgate order that has the latest fulfilled date among the member's orders in fulfilled status, on a shared latest date the order of them recorded first has its Northgate Cash earning on the membership's ledger, when the line is not of a purchase type that never earns Northgate Cash, the membership is not canceled on its order's fulfilled date, the Northgate Cash earned on the membership in the twelve whole calendar months before today is below the tier's annual Northgate Cash limit and the line's earning under the Business earning schedule comes to at least one cent.

The Business refund is not worked out until the most recent return recorded on the member's Northgate orders, the one with the latest return date and, among returns of the same date, the one recorded first carries its reversal on the membership's ledger, when the earning basis recorded on the Northgate Cash earning that points to its line differs from that line's kept-units basis, which is the line's net amount times the units bought less every unit refunded without a return on the line, divided by the units bought and rounded half up to the cent, less the merchandise refunded on every return of the line.

Before the Business refund is worked out, the most recent refund without a return made because an item was damaged on arrival or never received on the member's Northgate orders, the one with the latest refund date and, among refunds of one kind on that date, the one recorded first, and when a damaged-on-arrival refund and a never-received refund share that date, the damaged-on-arrival refund must carry its reversal on the membership's ledger, when the earning basis recorded on the Northgate Cash earning that points to its line differs from that line's kept-units basis, which is the line's net amount times the units bought less every unit refunded without a return on the line, divided by the units bought and rounded half up to the cent, less the merchandise refunded on every return of the line.

**Refund basis recorded.** The Business refund is recorded with basis `full_within_window` when the fee was charged no more than the tier's annual full refund window days before the cancellation date, and with basis `prorated_unused_months` otherwise.

## Closure tool `confirm_business_membership_closure_a0a2c96c`

**Capability.** The business's administrator confirms, in person, the immediate closure of the business's own Northgate+ Business membership together with the refund of its annual fee. One call records the closure request as confirmed and closes the membership today (status canceled, auto-renew off, cancellation date today). When the refund is above 0.00 the call also books one refund entry against the annual fee charge, credited to the external debit or credit card that fee was charged to; when the refund is 0.00 it books no refund entry. The administrator sees the membership closed and, when a refund is booked, the refund on that card.

**Invocation.** A customer tool: the agent unlocks `confirm_business_membership_closure_a0a2c96c` and hands it over, and the customer themselves — the business's administrator — runs it. The call succeeds when the receipt reports status "canceled".

**Parameters**

- `membership_id` — the membership identifier of the business's own membership record being closed, as returned by the membership lookup and read to the administrator by the agent.
- `original_event_id` — the ledger entry identifier of the annual fee charge the refund is booked against, as returned by the membership ledger lookup and read to the administrator by the agent.
- `refund_basis` — the basis the refund is booked under, one of: `full_within_window` when the cancellation falls inside the annual fee's full refund window; `prorated_unused_months` when the cancellation falls after that window and the refund covers the unused months of the term; `billing_error` when the fee being refunded was charged in error (a second charge for the same billing period, or a charge for a period starting on or after a confirmed cancellation). `not_applicable` marks ledger entries that are not fee refunds and is refused on this refund.
- `refund_amount_usd` — the refund the administrator confirms, in US dollars with 2 decimal places, 0.00 or positive; values with more decimals or below 0.00 are refused, never rounded by the tool. With 0.00 the cancellation is recorded and no refund entry is booked.

**Return.** One of two text receipts. When the refund is above 0.00: "Membership <membership_id> canceled on <cancel_date>: request <request_ref> confirmed, refund <refund_ref> of <refund_amount_usd> USD against fee <original_event_id> with basis <refund_basis> credited to the external card, status canceled." When the refund is 0.00: "Membership <membership_id> canceled on <cancel_date>: request <request_ref> confirmed, refund none of 0.00 USD, no refund entry booked against fee <original_event_id>, status canceled." The cancellation date is today's date (YYYY-MM-DD); the request reference is the new request reference and the refund reference the new refund entry reference; the amount is two-decimal US dollars.

**Errors.** A text beginning "Error:" means nothing was changed because an argument broke the formats above or the membership reference is unknown.
